data.body: Inventory reconciliation note: the initial current-main path census found 213 old `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` paths moved to `tests/unit/reconciler/` and 28 historical paths deleted across 18 mixed leaves. These leaves retain live work; deleted anchors are being removed from their Scope/file_impact and focused commands rather than closing whole leaves. The epic's original 1,514-row execution and 1,499-row migration targets were written for the historical inventory and must be recomputed against final live Scope/file_impact before the six story logs and epic close; do not claim those counts pass merely from the retired source ledger.
